title: Implement a candidate direct Domain-to-Contracts reference slice of IFX L2.2
goal: Build and test a scoped public-extension candidate for one non-vacuous architecture rule slice, correcting the earlier L1.2/L2.9 equivalence assumption without touching V4 core or release bytes.
acceptanceCriteria: C1a records the L1.2/L2.9 semantic correction; both remain uncovered, and the L2.2 implementation is explicitly partial.
A hashed, schema-valid candidate module and rule plan run only as a read-only V4 Pre PowerShell adapter with default-deny capabilities.
Clean, violating, missing-root, zero-Domain and unsafe-reference fixtures pass, including exact finding/category/coverage and target-byte invariance checks.
Formal Pre/Diff, isolated IFX package test and unchanged published V4 Package hash pass; no bundle review, composition, release or installed-tree change occurs.
